title: vibrant golden polish beurre-noisette tagine
description: a show-off polish dish featuring beurre-noisette, cooked in a low-fat friendly tagine-cooked ramekin, tender and grassy.
instructions: preheat the tagine to 375 degrees fahrenheit.
in a bowl, whisk together the softened butter, brown mustard seeds, honey, and white wine vinegar until smooth.
add the minced garlic and mix until well combined.
add the chopped parsley and lemon zest and mix until well combined.
add the whisked eggs and mix until smooth.
add the grated cheddar cheese and mix until well combined.
add the chopped dill and mix until well combined.
ladle the mixture into 4 ramekins and cover with a layer of foil.
place the ramekins in the preheated tagine and cook for 20 minutes.
remove the foil and cook for an additional 10 minutes, or until the tops are golden brown.
serve the vibrant golden polish beurre-noisette tagine warm, garnished with additional chopped parsley if desired.
